title: Bisleri Water Sample Mein Mila Coliform Bacteria, FSSAI Ne Prosecution Ko Di Manzuri
summary: FSSAI ne West Bengal ke ek Bisleri sample mein coliform bacteria milne par prosecution ki manzuri di hai. Company ne batch recall kar lab results par review maanga hai.
key_points: West Bengal ke Jalpaiguri facility ke Batch PB201 mein FSSAI ko coliform bacteria mila.
Goa plant ke baad Bisleri par regulatory prosecution action ki yeh doosri manzuri hai.
Bisleri ne FSSAI ke kehne par affected batch ko market se pehle hi recall kar liya hai.
Company ka daawa hai ki 2 independent labs ki testing mein paani safety standards par sahi mila.
body: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) ne Bisleri International ke khilaaf prosecution ki manzuri di hai. West Bengal ke Jalpaiguri district ke Telipara facility se liye gaye packaged drinking water ke sample mein coliform bacteria paaye gaye, jise primary aur referral dono labs ne unsafe bataya.

FSSAI ne August 2026 mein hi Batch PB201 ki sale par ban laga diya tha. Goa plant ke sample ke baad Bisleri par regulatory action aur prosecution ki yeh doosri manzuri hai. Iske saath hi FSSAI ne sabhi rajyon ko packaged drinking water brands ki inspection aur sampling badhane ke nirdesh diye hain.

Bisleri International ne apne statement mein bataya ki unhone FSSAI ke nirdesh par us specific batch ko pehle hi market se recall kar liya tha. Company ne do alag FSSAI-recognised independent labs se bhi is batch ki testing karwayi, jahan paani ke samples saare safety standards par sahi paaye gaye.

Independent aur regulatory lab results mein antar dekh kar Bisleri ne FSSAI se sampling process aur testing methodology ki thorough review karne ki maang ki hai. Company ne kaha ki unka 10-step manufacturing process aur 90 se zyada quality checks safety maintain karte hain aur woh FSSAI ke saath poora sahyog kar rahe hain.
why_it_matters: Bottled drinking water daily life aur travel mein widespread use hota hai. Safety regulator ke is action aur surveillance drive se market mein bikne wale packaged water ki quality maintain rakhne mein madad milegi.
